name: io.github.fr0ster/mcp-abap-adt
description: MCP server for SAP ABAP ADT: repository analysis and CRUD for RAP and classic ABAP
note: Live-tested finding: this package does NOT read the environmentVariables below from the process environment (i.e. .mcp.json's own 'env' block does nothing for tools/call). Use --env=<destination> (see mcpConfig below), which resolves to a .env file at ~/.config/mcp-abap-adt/sessions/<destination>.env, outside any project directory. The env vars are documented here only to describe what that destination .env file must contain.

variables.name: SAP_URL
variables.description: Base URL of the ABAP system (on-prem host or BTP ABAP service URL). Required to connect.

variables.name: SAP_AUTH_TYPE
variables.description: 'basic' for username/password (on-prem) or 'jwt'/'xsuaa' for JWT/OAuth2 (BTP ABAP Cloud).

variables.name: SAP_SYSTEM_TYPE
variables.description: Controls which tools are available (e.g. Programs are onprem-only). Must be set to 'onprem' for on-premise systems, default is 'cloud'.

variables.name: SAP_CLIENT
variables.description: ABAP client/mandant number. Required for basic auth; optional for BTP ABAP Cloud.

variables.name: SAP_JWT_TOKEN
variables.description: JWT bearer token, required when SAP_AUTH_TYPE=jwt/xsuaa. Never commit.

variables.name: SAP_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password, required when SAP_AUTH_TYPE=basic. Never commit.

variables.name: SAP_MASTER_SYSTEM
variables.description: System context for on-prem create/update operations (e.g. DEV).

variables.name: SAP_RESPONSIBLE
variables.description: Responsible user for on-prem create/update operations.
